description: Compiles an automation’s version and stores the result so it can be switched on. It does not switch the automation on. Each deploy needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it deploys. version_id defaults to the newest version; confirm_actions names, one by one, each destructive action of the automation the person approved. A confirmed deploy that fails to compile uses up the confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: deploy_automation
title: Deploy an automation
